redistribution_classes.meaning: AGID-created metadata and non-production fixtures only.
Public official pages, standards, laws, services or viewers retained as references; access does not imply row or redistribution rights.
An exact artifact whose dataset-specific licence permits recorded public fields and derivatives, with owner, edition, coverage, schema, CRS, validity, attribution and digest pinned.
Registered, licensed, request-delivered or restricted material used and redistributed only as specifically permitted.
Personal, holder, correspondence, unclear-license, search-only or non-redistributable evidence may detect discrepancies but cannot become public output.

sources.provider: Universal Postal Union with South African Post Office
sources.production_scope: The country sheet defines four digits and distinguishes physical, rural and postal-delivery-service addresses. It supplies no current national assignment table, office dataset, catchment or polygon.

A pinned SAPO-controlled record may validate its four-digit code, delivery locality, post office and delivery type at capture time. Completeness, historical validity, geometry and redistribution require separate proof.
Search results are fallback validation evidence only unless provenance, SAPO authority, coverage, terms, edition and redistribution rights are pinned.

NGI establishes national mapping, geodetic control, aerial imagery and topographic context. Each exact product retains its own access, licence, CRS, edition and digest; the authority page is not feature data.
Pinned Stats SA geography can supply its stated province, municipality and census hierarchy. Exact edition and licence must be reviewed; statistical boundaries do not establish postal delivery areas.
The Spatial Data Infrastructure Act governs sharing, standards, metadata and custodianship. It is legal metadata, not a dataset licence, postal assignment or geometry artifact.

sources.provider: Department of Land Reform and Rural Development
sources.production_scope: The NSPDR portal documents credential and disclaimer boundaries. Portal visibility or searchability does not supply a reusable postal, address or building artifact.

artifact_partitions.contents: Pinned SAPO code, delivery locality or office, delivery type, validity and lineage; no inferred polygon.
Permitted exact office points separate from postal delivery surfaces and civic addresses.
Physical, rural, PO Box and Private Bag evidence retained as distinct typed records.
Optional versioned, uncertainty-bearing, non-canonical surfaces derived only from rights-cleared inputs.
Civic address points and exact rights-cleared building joins kept separate from postal endpoints.
Separately licensed province, municipality and statistical geography with source CRS and edition.
Endpoint holders, recipients, contacts, correspondence, residents, occupants, owners, title and query evidence excluded from public artifacts.
